title: On the squareness of the discriminant of elliptic curves with an isogeny
summary: We establish a classification of the values of \( N \) for which an elliptic curve defined over \( \mathbb{Q} \) with square discriminant admits an \( N \)-isogeny. Furthermore, we determine the values of \( N \) for which two elliptic curves defined over \( \mathbb{Q} \), both possessing square discriminants, are \( N \)-isogenous. In both cases, we explicitly parametrize the corresponding \( j \)-invariants of the elliptic curves associated with these problems.
